item.title: Phend Signs With J&T
item.description: Dakotah Phend has signed with J&T for bearings and accessories in 2026.

item.title: Moran Joins Team Powers USA
item.description: TeamPowers USA is proud to announce Sammy Moran has joined the 2026 Race Team of exceptional drivers!

item.title: Haatanen Runs Ruddog Electronics
item.description: Following his joining of RUDDOG Distribution as a full-time employee in early 2025, Joona will now be running the full range of RUDDOG Racing electronics in his Team Associated cars.

item.title: Butterfield Joins Team Associated
item.description: Bryce Butterfield has announced that he will be joining the Team Associated Team for 2026 to race the TC8 as well as doing some off-road events.

item.title: Neumann Signs With WIRC
item.description: WIRC has announced that world champion Jorn Neumann will be joining the team for 2026.

item.title: Talon Henley Joins Matrix Tires
item.description: Talon Henley has joined Matrix Tires for 2026.

item.title: New R1 Wurks R1B Teaser Photos
item.description: R1 Wurks has a 2wd buggy platform on the way and they have shared their first teaser photos of the R1B decked out in dirt trim.

item.title: Gotzl Partners With Team Exalt
item.description: Team Exalt is proud to officially welcome Max Götzl to the Exalt family for the 2026 racing season.

item.title: Beach RC and Dynamic Performance RC Announce Partnership
item.description: BeachRC x Dynamic Performance RC are now partners! By combining their warehouses, shipping networks, and inventories, they are creating a one-stop-shop powerhouse for the RC industry.

item.title: Boots Signs With GRP Tires
item.description: GRP Tires is excited to announce the signing of Elliott Boots to the factory team for 2026.
